bullets.text: 5G Spectrum Auction Coming - Ofcom will auction 5.4 GHz of mmWave spectrum, the largest release in UK history.
OpenAI Restructures with Microsoft - New deal allows OpenAI to pursue a for-profit model and future IPO.
Nvidia and OpenAI Invest Billions - Major investments in UK data centers expected during President Trump's visit.
6G's Undefined Future - Analysts question the economic viability and clear definition of 6G technology.
Neighborhood AI Factories Emerge - Telco central offices are transforming into hubs for AI workloads.
US Data Center Spending Soars - Record $40B in spending driven by AI and machine learning demands.
OpenAI's $300B Cloud Deal - Major agreement with Oracle to secure computing power for AI expansion.
Unabiz Restructures Sigfox - Court grants six months for Unabiz to restructure €5m debt in France.
EE's 5G Speed Solution - Advanced RAN Coordination aims to eliminate slow 5G speeds in crowded areas.
SpaceX Acquires Spectrum - Key acquisition for Starlink's Direct to Cell mobile service expansion.
